statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and a sensation of rapid heart rate
There is clinical suspicion for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia
CPT code 93271 (cardiac event monitoring study) was billed
Diagnosis codes I47.1, I48.0, and R00.2 were submitted
The claim was denied with reason code CO-97
The service is indicated to capture the rhythm during intermittent symptomatic events and guide further management
Less intensive monitoring options were attempted and deemed insufficient prior to initiating this level of care
